text:
Nishant: Quick sync — inference perf readout/optimization review. Proposed 30m slot next week (Mon/Tue). Need someone to present the latency/cost dashboard + benchmark methodology. Link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/infer-perf (prelim).

Nishant: Proposed agenda:
```1) Bench readout (15m)
2) Latency/cost tradeoffs (10m)
3) Actions & owners (5m)
```

Nishant: Preferred times: Mon 10:00am PT or Mon 3:00pm PT. Pre-reads: perf deck (PR #342) + perf scripts. Who can take dashboard + bench methodology?

Eva: I can present the dashboard. 10:00am PT works for me. I'll push a read-only copy of the deck to the drive. :white_check_mark:

Sam: I can cover the benchmark methodology and quant/throughput experiments. 3pm PT is ok if the team prefers — but I can do 10am too. @Eva let's do a quick 15m sync before the readout to align metrics.

Lucy: Either slot is fine for me. I can add a 5m note about routing/fallback perf differences we saw in canary.

Mira: Please add me as note-taker. I'll capture action items and open follow-ups in the tracker. Also can someone attach the raw CSVs or point me to them?

Nishant: Tentative: Mon 10:00am PT with Eva (dashboard), Sam (bench/method), Lucy (fallback note). Mira notes. @deploy-bot can you create a calendar invite with Zoom link?

deploy-bot: Calendar event created — "Inference Perf Review" Mon 10:00am PT. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789. Invite sent to participants.

Sam: Quick ask — can we add target SLOs into the agenda so the readout maps results to goals? Example table below I'll paste:
```Targets:
p50 <= 60ms
p95 <= 120ms
cost <= $0.002/token (amortized)
```

Eva: Added pre-reads: perf-deck-v2 (drive) and perf scripts in infra/perf repo. @Mira DMing CSV locations now.

Nishant: Also small ops ask: PR #348 (KV-cache change) needs a quick review before the run. @Lucy @Sam can you take a look by EOD Fri?

Lucy: On it, will review today and leave comments.

Mira: Noted, taking minutes for the readout and will file follow-up PERF tickets (adding PERF-42 for quant followups).

Nishant: :thumbsup: Thanks all — will finalize agenda and attach the pre-read links to the invite. If anyone needs a different slot, shout now.
